_about: Products from the owner's listing sheet 'Wisdomup Products Data for listing Claud.xlsx' that the two supplier quote sheets do not carry (added 2026-10-14, "also replace these with model numbers if there is no product list create new one"). tools/build_catalog.py builds each into catalog.js like a supplier product: `price` = the sheet's 'Online Price' column (the regular price; the shop.js sale applies on top, like every product), `specs` = clean technical facts from its 'Technical Specification' row under the site's own labels (no brand, barcode, made-in or marketing words; the driver maker's name left out), `highlights` / `meta` in the builder's own phrasing. The photo must exist as site/img/p/<id>.jpg — put it in with tools/set_photo.py first. tools/check_listing_specs.py checks the price and every number here against the sheet row named in `from`.
